Remarks

This class provides methods to fracture a polygon by cutting it with another polygon and subdividing the resulting pieces.

Parameters

minArea float

The minimum area for a fracture piece to be kept.

maxArea float

The maximum area for a fracture piece to be kept.

keepChance float

The probability that a generated fracture piece will be kept. Default is 0.5.

narrowValue float

Controls how narrow the generated fracture pieces can be. Default is 0.2.

Methods

Fracture(Polygon, Polygon, FractureInfo)

Fractures a polygon by cutting it with another polygon and subdividing the resulting pieces.

public void Fracture(Polygon shape, Polygon cutShape, FractureInfo result)

Parameters

shape Polygon

The original polygon to be fractured.

cutShape Polygon

The polygon used to cut the original shape.

result FractureInfo

A FractureInfo object containing the new shapes, cutouts, and fracture pieces.

Remarks

  • The method first computes the intersection and difference between the original shape and the cut shape.
  • The intersection pieces are triangulated and subdivided according to the area and randomness parameters.
